name: Would You Rather
blurb: Two options, both hard to pick. Choose one, then defend it.

howToPlay: Everyone picks A or B. No abstaining.
Then everyone defends their pick. That is the game.
Swipe up when the easy ones stop being interesting.

tiers.name: Revealing
